name: Llama
short_description: Llama is a family of large language models released by Meta AI, with open weights that can be downloaded and run on local hardware.

evidence.quote: Today, I will show you how to run Lama locally, connect it to your SharePoint libraries, and build a retrieval system
Lama 4 Scout deserves specific mention here because it represents the current state of the art in open-weight models
